core_obligations: Define the base change map through a compactification and record that g flat supplies the Tor independence needed (proof lines 5011-5034).
Reduce the bijectivity of the base change map to the affine case using affine locality of the adjoint and conclude with the flat affine statement (proof lines 5036-5041).

difficulty_reason: In Situation labelled situation-shriek, for a cartesian diagram of FTS_S with g flat, the lemma asserts an isomorphism L(g')^* o f^! -> (f')^! o Lg^* on D^+_QCoh(O_Y) (statement lines 4996-5009). The proof notes that flatness of g makes every compactification X -> Xbar of X over Y Tor independent of Y', lets j' : X' -> Xbar' be the base change of j and gbar' the projection, and defines the base change map as the composition L(g')^* o j^* o a = (j')^* o L(gbar')^* o a -> (j')^* o a' o Lg^* = (f')^! o Lg^*, where the middle arrow is the base change map of equation labelled equation-base-change-map and a, a' are the right adjoints for the two structural morphisms (proof lines 5011-5030). The proof states that this construction is independent of the choice of compactification, and remarks that a precise lemma will be formulated and proved if the result is ever needed (proof lines 5030-5034). It remains to show that the base change map L(g')^* o a -> a' o Lg^* is an isomorphism on D^+_QCoh(O_Y): since by Lemma labelled lemma-proper-noetherian the formation of a and a' commutes with restriction to affine opens, Remark labelled remark-check-over-affines reduces this to affine Y and Y', where it is Lemma labelled lemma-more-base-change (proof lines 5036-5041). Recognising that flatness supplies the Tor independence making the compactification construction applicable, and reducing the isomorphism to the affine case, is the non-formal step, so the claim is H2; the deferred independence statement is recorded verbatim in the notes.
